name: io.github.WYRE-AI/webfleet-mcp
title: Webfleet
description: Read-only MCP server for Bridgestone Webfleet (WEBFLEET.connect): vehicles, drivers, trips, tracks, events, KPIs, addresses, and orders.

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Webfleet user with the WEBFLEET.connect access right (sent only via HTTP Basic Auth).

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of that user (sent only via HTTP Basic Auth).

environmentVariables.name: WEBFLEET_TOOL_TIERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool tiers. Every tool is read-only, so the only valid value is read (the default). The X-Conduit-Tool-Tiers request header can only narrow this set.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Must be 'stdio' when run from the registry; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads WEBFLEET_* locally; 'gateway' expects the X-Webfleet-* headers from the WYRE MCP Gateway and never reads env. The image sets 'gateway', so registry clients must set 'env'.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
